claim: Two families of explicit, non-axisymmetric, two-field-period toroidal MHD equilibria (equivalently steady incompressible Euler flows) with exact nested flux surfaces are given in closed form in Cartesian coordinates. The first family (parameter 0<eps<1) has a rotational transform that is the same on every flux surface. The second family (parameters eps, S, lambda) has a sheared transform profile. The explicit formulas for B and p satisfy (curl B) x B = grad p exactly.

quantities.description: Rotational transform of the first family (B from eq. B_cartesian with s, F from eq. auxiliary, a=sqrt(1+eps), b=sqrt(1-eps)). It is defined as Delta(theta)/Delta(phi) over one field-line period, where phi is the toroidal angle and theta = arg[(R-R_a) - i(z - Z_a(phi))] is the geometric poloidal angle measured from the magnetic axis gamma(zeta) = (sqrt(1-eps^2) cos zeta, sqrt(1-eps^2) sin zeta, (eps/2) sin 2zeta). Evaluate it on any flux surface 0<psi<=delta of the domain Omega_delta. The paper's example is eps=1/2, delta=1/64. The value is surface-independent.

On-axis rotational transform iota(0) of the sheared family with eps=2, S=1 (k_b=0.1, delta=1/200; lambda does not enter). Use the limit k->0 of eq. sheared_iota, which equals h0*H(eps) with h0 = sqrt(4 S^2 + eps^2) and H(eps) = (1/2pi) * integral over 0..2pi of sech(nu(zeta)) dzeta, where nu(zeta) = (eps/2) sin 2zeta. Report the full-precision value.

Rotational transform iota(delta) of the sheared family on the outermost surface psi=delta=1/200 (k=k_b=sqrt(2 delta)=0.1), with eps=2 and S=1 (lambda does not enter). Compute it as the long-time average winding iota = lim_{N->inf} [chi(zeta+2piN)-chi(zeta)]/(2piN). Here chi obeys dchi/dzeta = 2 G(sigma,zeta) sqrt(1-k^2 sin^2 chi) / sqrt(cosh^2 nu(zeta) - k^2), with G = (h(sigma)+eps cos 2zeta)/2, h(sigma)=sqrt(4 sigma^2+eps^2), nu=(eps/2) sin 2zeta. sigma is evaluated from eq. sheared_sigma with X=-k cos chi, Y=k sin chi. Report the full-precision value (converged in N and integration tolerance).

Relative force-balance residual |(curl B) x B - grad p| / |grad p| of the first family's explicit formulas, with B from eqs. B_cartesian/auxiliary and p = p_a - 2 psi, psi = (x^2+y^2+4z^2+|B|^2-2+eps^2)/4 (p_a irrelevant). Use eps=1/2. All derivatives are taken exactly (symbolic or automatic differentiation) and evaluated in double precision. The sample points are on the surface psi=delta=1/64 at r(u,v,zeta) from eq. embedding, with u = -eps/2 + sqrt(delta) cos alpha and v = sqrt(delta) sin alpha. List the residuals for (alpha,zeta) = (0,0), (pi/2,pi/4), (pi,pi/3), in that order. These sample points were chosen for this test and are not stated in the paper.

Relative force-balance residual |(curl B) x B - grad p| / |grad p| of the sheared family's explicit formulas, with B from eq. sheared_B (K = conj(omega) sqrt(1+eps/conj(omega)^2), using the square root with positive real part, and Xi = omega K + pi/2 - S) and p = p_a - psi/lambda^2, with psi from eq. sheared_pressure (p_a irrelevant). Use eps=2, S=1, lambda=1 (the paper leaves lambda free; lambda=1 is a choice made for this test). All derivatives are taken exactly (symbolic or automatic differentiation) and evaluated in double precision. The sample points are on the surface k=k_b=0.1 at r(X,Y,zeta) from eq. sheared_embedding with sigma from eq. sheared_sigma, X=-k cos chi, Y=k sin chi. List the residuals for (chi,zeta) = (0,0), (pi/2,pi/4), (pi,pi/3), in that order. These sample points were chosen for this test and are not stated in the paper.
